rows.desc: open — {username, password}; cab shadows every signed-in account (guests are participants with no account)
the claiming account — {claim_token}; attaches a participant with no account (a guest's place, an accepted invitation); single use
admin — {sourceUserId, targetUserId, displayName}; moves participations, anonymises the source; only for merging two real accounts

rows.path: /api/organisations, PUT /:id, POST /:id/owners, DEL /:id/owners/:uid
rows.desc: admin create {name, owner_id}; a club rename renames the organisation first (PUT /:id as the head, a refusal keeps the old name in cab too); change-head adds the new owner and removes the old; a merge hands the folded account's clubs over first

rows.path: /api/events, GET/PUT /:id, DEL /:id
rows.desc: org — create, read, status (completed on finish), soft archive

org — {user_id?, role}; without user_id the engine returns a one-time raw_claim_token (guests, invitations). DEL 409 once placed in a room. PUT /:pid renames (removal scrubs the name to "removed", a claim gives the account's name) and re-roles (chairs at Start).
org — rooms take {adjudicators:[chair], teams:[{name, participant_ids(1-2), position}]} INLINE TEMP teams; 1 pid = iron (engine duplicates the speaker); DEL pending only → rebuild
read — rooms + teams + RoomSpeakers {rank, is_iron, Scores} + per-room Motion with created_at
chair — {motion_text, infoslide?} creates RELEASED motion + rooms.motion_id atomically; cab calls it on PUBLISH (draft+keyword live gateway-side)
chair or owner — {prep_ends_at}; rooms.prep_ends_at, also settable on POST /api/rooms/:id/motion (prep_ends_at); room reads carry it. cab sets it as the club head and keeps no prep time of its own

chair, or owner fall-through (guest chairs go through the head) — 8 speeches keyed per SLOT + teamRankings 1..4; a score may carry is_iron (one of an iron-person's two speeches; default the later) and participant_id (the team member who actually spoke)
org (no chair fall-through on confirm — cab confirms as head after its judge gate); no reopen: completed accepts resubmission as atomic replace, a ballot is never wiped

a member of the issuing team (or anyone while the team has an unclaimed member) — {adjudicator_id, issuer_team_id, comment?, answers [{key, value}]}; checked against the event's questions; score = average of the counting answers (7 and 8 make 7.5); one per issuer per adjudicator (409)
read — raw room→rank; calculated: teams Σ(N−rank), speakers Σ(score×(1+(N−rank)×0.1)); an iron speech never counts for the speaker

groups.title: stats + user reads (merged in the engine)

rows.desc: per speaker: TOTAL, AVG, STD of speaker points (iron speeches left out) — not called by cab yet
per team: total speaker points, counts of 1st and 4th places — not called by cab yet (standings use the calculated endpoints)
club strength: total sessions, avg WINNER speaker points, avg 4TH-PLACE speaker points — not called by cab yet (standings use the calculated endpoints)

per adjudicator: rooms_adjudicated, avg_feedback — with base, the base counts as one vote: (base + sum) ÷ (count + 1); cab calls it for the Adjudicators standings tab and the adjudicator's own average
read — My page Stats, shown verbatim (iron speeches left out)
read — My page History in ONE call
read — My page My schedule
any signed-in caller — the event's form: key, label, type (integer | text | boolean | choice), range or choices, required, counts_in_score, position
owner or organiser — cab adds accuracy and reasoning (integer 1–10, required, counting) when a session opens

rows.t: engine: change or remove a question
rows.desc: owner or organiser — refused (409) once the question has answers, so recorded feedback keeps its meaning
owner or organiser — every feedback with its answers, computed score, issuer team and adjudicator; cab reads it as the club head
